Organising your library

Folders, colours, the trash, the archive, bulk tools and search.

#Unsorted, Favourites and other views of All notes

All notes is the one place for your whole library: folders, loose pages, favourites and more, chosen with the pills above the list.

  1. All shows your folders and the pages that are in no folder; Folders shows only folders.
  2. Unsorted shows the pages that are in no folder. “Organise” (the round button) moves them into a folder in one go.
  3. Favourites gathers every page you starred, from any folder: right-click a page → Add to favourites, or use ••• while it is open. A ★ marks them everywhere.
  4. Daily notes and With tasks appear when you have some: every daily note, and every page that still has unticked checklist items.
  5. Inside a folder the pills are All, Folders, Notes and Favourites for that folder.

#Folders and moving things

Drag and drop between the left bar and the dashboard, or use Move to… / Copy to….

  1. Drag a page or folder onto a folder to move it; drop between items to reorder.
  2. Drop onto another page to group two pages into a new folder (Alt-drop nests a page under a page).
  3. Right-click anything for rename, colour, duplicate, move, copy and delete.

#Colours

Give folders and pages a colour so they stand out in the left bar and the dashboard.

  1. Right-click → Set colour (or ••• → Set colour while a page is open).

#Trash, archive and restoring

Deleted pages go to the Trash; archived pages are hidden but kept.

  1. Delete moves a page (or a folder and its pages) to the Trash. Open Trash to Restore or Delete forever.
  2. ••• → Archive page hides a page from lists; show archived pages with the “Archived” pill, or restore it from the same menu.
  3. Dragging onto the Trash row also deletes.

#Table view and bulk actions

See your pages as a sortable table and change many at once.

  1. On All notes, a folder, a label or Recent switch to the table view.
  2. Tick pages to move them, add a label, set a status, merge them into one or send them to the trash.

#Space home

A top-level folder shows a front page with a description, counts, recent updates, labels and projects.

  1. Open a top-level folder and click “Add a description” to write one.
  2. Export links on that page save the folder as Markdown, HTML or a website.

#Search

Ctrl+K searches titles, labels, owners and the text of every page, plus tasks, whiteboards and app pages.

  1. Type to search; use the filters for label, folder, status, owner and modified date.
  2. Tick “Archived” to include archived pages.

#Search operators and saved searches

Narrow a search by typing operators — click one under the search box to insert it.

  1. label:design (or #design) · in:Work (a folder or parent page) · status:draft · owner:sam · is:favourite · is:daily · is:task (pages with open checklist items) · is:unsorted · is:archived
  2. has:reminder · before:2026-10-01 · after:2026-01-01 · edited:week (day, week or month) · type:task (or page, folder, board)
  3. “exact phrase” keeps words together; -word leaves out pages that contain it.
  4. ☆ Save this search keeps it as a chip above the results for next time.

#The graph of linked pages

See how your notes connect.

  1. Ctrl+Shift+P → “Open the graph…”, or Insights → Graph.
  2. Every page with a [[link]] (or a child page) is a dot; bigger dots have more links. Hover to highlight a page’s neighbours, click to open it, scroll to zoom and drag to move around.
  3. Find a page by name, show only one type, or include pages with no links.

#Insights and review cycles

See which pages need attention (the Insights page in the left bar).

  1. Insights lists pages that need review, are stale (90+ days), most viewed, never opened, have broken [[links]] or stand alone.
  2. In a page’s properties set “Review every N months”; “Mark verified” resets the clock.
